label: Riverbend County (fictional teaching county)
disclaimer: Every value in this file is invented for teaching and software testing. None is a Pennsylvania rate, caseload, prevalence estimate, network size, or policy rule. Results are conditional on these assumptions and are not forecasts or causal findings.

population.note: Small fictional enrolled population chosen so runs are fast and readable.

weekly_need_onset_rate.unit: new care-seeking episodes per enrolled person per week
weekly_need_onset_rate.note: Produces roughly 7-8 new people seeking outpatient therapy per week. Not calibrated to any real prevalence or utilization data.

sessions_needed_min.note: Lower bound of a uniform draw for episode length. Not a clinical standard.

sessions_needed_max.note: Upper bound of a uniform draw for episode length. Not a clinical standard.

provider_count.note: Fictional network size chosen so baseline is capacity-constrained and a waitlist forms.

weekly_caseload_min.note: Each provider receives a fixed number of weekly slots drawn between min and max.

weekly_caseload_max.note: Upper bound for fictional provider capacity.

no_show_probability.note: A missed session uses the slot but produces no claim.

weekly_waitlist_dropout.note: Chance a waiting person stops seeking care through this network in a given week. Leaving the waitlist is counted as unmet need in the model, not as recovery.

weekly_treatment_dropout.unit: probability per week while in care
weekly_treatment_dropout.note: Chance an active client stops attending before the planned episode ends.

allowed_amount_cents_per_session.note: Toy allowed amount ($90.00) used by the toy adjudication rule. Not a fee schedule.

capitation_pmpm_cents.unit: integer cents per enrolled person per month
capitation_pmpm_cents.note: Toy prospective payment from the fictional state program to the fictional managed-care organization. Recorded as a transfer and never counted as a system cost.

baseline.label: Baseline (no pilot)
baseline.description: The fictional county as configured above.

care_coordination_pilot.label: The Waitlist Check-In Pilot
care_coordination_pilot.description: A fictional coordinator sends reminders and checks in with people on the waitlist. The assumed effects below are invented to show how a model works; they are not evidence that any real program has these effects.
